in_sanskrit.name: गोकिली
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is the dearest to Lord Govinda, also known as Gokeshvari or Govindakalpana.

in_hindi.name: गोकिली
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who is dearest to Lord Govinda.

in_tamil.name: கோகிலி
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who is beloved by the temple deity or Lord Kovil.

in_telugu.name: గోకిలీ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is the master of Gopala or Govinda.

in_marathi.name: Gokili
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gokili हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Gokili is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Gaukari’, which means 'Cow protector'. The name is associated with the goddess Gau Mata or Kamadhenu, who represents the mother of all cows and is revered for her abundant nourishment and protection.
